initial_scene: Seated humanoid faces the table. A silver kettle with a dark lid and handle rests separately from its black circular wired base. Anatomical right hand is extended toward the kettle; left hand lies open over the left thigh.

observed_sequence.action: Right arm extends toward the separate kettle while the left hand stays on the lap; kettle and base remain on the table.
Right hand reaches the kettle handle and closes around its upper handle region. The kettle begins to rise.
Right hand lifts kettle clear of the tabletop and carries it inward over the circular base; at frame 246 the bottom is visibly above the base.
Right hand lowers kettle onto the circular base, keeping it upright; base remains visible as a rim underneath.
Right hand remains at handle holding the placed kettle steady with small settling adjustments; left hand does not support the kettle or base.
Right fingers open and release the handle, moving clear while kettle remains upright on the base.
Right arm retracts toward the torso, leaving the kettle undisturbed on its base; left hand remains on lap.
